name: UniMall Front Roundal
description: Central student hub with food courts, stores, brand outlets, and pathways connecting hostels, main gate, and robopark.

name: Main Gate 1 (GT Road Entrance)
description: Primary campus entrance facing Grand Trunk Road with security check, visitor registration, and auto stands.

name: Central Library (Block 34)
description: Multi-storey central university library with 1.5M+ books, automated e-resource labs, quiet study floors, and conference halls.

name: Block 32 (School of Computer Science & Engg)
description: Major tech academic block housing AI, Cloud, Cybersecurity, and Software Engineering computing labs and lecture theatres.

name: Block 38 (Robotics, IoT & Mechanical Labs)
description: Advanced engineering workshops, 3D printing labs, drone simulation spaces, and mechanical testing bays.

name: Baldev Raj Mittal Unipolis
description: Iconic open-air amphitheatre with a capacity of 10,000+ students hosting cultural fests, star nights, and major hackathons.

name: Shanti Devi Mittal Auditorium
description: State-of-the-art air-conditioned auditorium hosting international conventions, guest lectures, and academic ceremonies.

name: Boys Hostel Complex (BH 1-4)
description: Residential towers for male students with integrated mess, badminton courts, laundry service, and 24/7 power backup.

name: Girls Hostel Complex (GH 1-3)
description: Secure residential complex for female students with internal courtyards, study zones, salon, and multi-cuisine cafeteria.

name: Indoor Sports Complex & Olympic Pool
description: World-class athletic facility featuring Olympic-size swimming pool, basketball arenas, squash courts, and fitness gymnasium.

name: UniHospital (Campus Medical Center)
description: 24/7 medical emergency center with resident doctors, pharmacy, diagnostic lab, and ambulance support for Vertos.
